  <dt>Formation Allegiance</dt>
  <dd>Each formation in an Emperor's Children army owes allegiance to the chaos god Slaanesh.</dd>

  <dd>The summoning point costs for an Emperor's Children army are below.</dd>
  <dd>

          <tr>
